meta.name: smart-explore
meta.description: Token-optimized structural code search using tree-sitter AST parsing. Use instead of reading full files when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase efficiently.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AST解析快速搜索代码结构，替代逐文件阅读
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在不熟悉的代码库中快速找到函数或结构
copy.tagline_en: Search code structure quickly with AST parsing, replacing full file reads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find functions or structures in unfamiliar codebases

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 探索代码时会改用 smart_search/smart_outline/smart_unfold:先搜出符号清单与文件骨架,再按需展开单个函数源码,不再先读整份文件。
howto.when: 当你要理解代码结构、找某个函数,或探索一个代码库时触发;它会接管默认的探索行为,改用结构搜索,而非 Read、Grep、Glob。

say.text: 搜索 ./src 里的 shutdown 相关符号
say.note: 返回带签名和行号的符号清单

say.text: 给我 services/worker-service.ts 的结构骨架
say.note: 列出该文件的函数、类和方法

say.text: 展开 worker-service.ts 里的 shutdown 函数源码
say.note: 返回该函数的完整实现

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude explores code with smart_search, smart_outline and smart_unfold: it first gets a symbol list and file skeleton, then unfolds only the function source it needs, instead of reading whole files.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you need to understand code structure, find a function, or explore a codebase; it then overrides default exploration and uses structural search instead of Read, Grep and Glob.

say_en.note: Returns ranked symbols with signatures and line numbers

say_en.text: Show me the outline of services/worker-service.ts
say_en.note: Lists functions, classes and methods in that file

say_en.text: Unfold the shutdown function in worker-service.ts
say_en.note: Returns the full source of that symbol
